card.opportunity_illinois: Advance to Illinois Ave. If you pass Go, collect $200.
card.opportunity_st_charles: Advance to St. Charles Place. If you pass Go, collect $200.
card.opportunity_nearest_utility: Advance to the nearest utility. If owned, roll the dice and pay ten times the result. If unowned, you may buy it.
card.opportunity_nearest_transport: Advance to the nearest railroad and pay double rent. If unowned, you may buy it.
card.opportunity_reading: Advance to Reading Railroad. If you pass Go, collect $200.
card.opportunity_jail: Go directly to Jail. Do not pass Go and do not collect $200.
card.opportunity_jail_free: Get out of Jail free. Keep this card until needed or sold.
card.opportunity_repairs: Make general repairs on all your property. Pay $25 per house and $100 per hotel.
card.opportunity_chairman: You have been elected chairman of the board. Pay each player $50.
card.opportunity_crossword: You won a crossword competition. Collect $100.
card.opportunity_rate_adjustment: Rate adjustment. Pay $300 with three or more complete groups; otherwise collect $100.
card.opportunity_advance_five: Advance five spaces. Buy an unowned property at a 10% discount.
card.community_bank_error: Bank error in your favor. Collect $200.
card.community_jail_free: Get out of Jail free. Keep this card until needed or sold.
card.community_jail: Go directly to Jail. Do not pass Go and do not collect $200.
card.community_opera: Grand opera opening. Collect $50 from every player.
card.community_birthday: It is your birthday. Collect $10 from every player.
card.community_repairs: You are assessed for street repairs. Pay $40 per house and $115 per hotel.
card.community_beauty: You won second prize in a beauty contest. Collect $10.
card.community_audit: Bank audit. Pay $25 for every property you own.
card.community_renewal_subsidy: Urban renewal subsidy. Collect $50 per mortgaged property.
card.community_refinance: Refinancing pays the principal, without interest, on the highest-value mortgage you can lift.
card.opportunity_fate_market_windfall: Market windfall. Collect the equivalent of two Start salaries.
card.opportunity_fate_hostile_audit: Hostile audit. Pay the equivalent of one and a half Start salaries.
card.opportunity_fate_parity_protocol: Parity protocol. Split your cash and the wealthiest player's cash equally.
card.opportunity_fate_unlikely_alliance: Unlikely alliance. Split your cash and the poorest player's cash equally.
card.opportunity_fate_identity_exchange: Identity exchange. Swap positions with the wealthiest player without triggering either destination.
card.opportunity_fate_reverse_ambush: Reverse ambush. Everyone moves back three spaces without triggering destinations.
card.opportunity_fate_collective_sprint: Collective sprint. Everyone advances five spaces and collects for passing Start, without triggering destinations.
card.opportunity_fate_leap_of_faith: Leap of faith. Advance twelve spaces. Buy an unowned property at a 25% discount.
card.opportunity_fate_second_chance: Second chance. Collect half a Start salary and move back four spaces.
card.opportunity_fate_power_vacuum: Power vacuum. Pay $50 to every player.
card.opportunity_fate_consolidation: Consolidation. If you own at least two complete groups, collect $200. Otherwise, pay $100.
card.opportunity_fate_property_boom: Property boom. Collect $30 for each property you own.
card.opportunity_fate_debt_reset: Debt reset. Lift the highest-value mortgage you can afford without interest.
card.opportunity_fate_emergency_pass: Emergency pass. Collect one Start salary and keep this card to leave jail.
card.opportunity_fate_new_cycle: New cycle. Advance to Start and collect the corresponding salary.
card.community_fate_civic_dividend: Civic dividend. Collect the equivalent of one and a half Start salaries.
card.community_fate_emergency_levy: Emergency levy. Pay the equivalent of one Start salary.
card.community_fate_common_ground: Common ground. Split your cash and the wealthiest player's cash equally.
card.community_fate_solidarity_pact: Solidarity pact. Split your cash and the poorest player's cash equally.
card.community_fate_seat_exchange: Seat exchange. Swap positions with the poorest player without triggering either destination.
card.community_fate_mass_migration: Mass migration. Everyone advances three spaces and collects for passing Start, without triggering destinations.
card.community_fate_city_retreat: City retreat. Everyone moves back two spaces without triggering destinations.
card.community_fate_neighborhood_fund: Neighborhood fund. Collect $25 from every player.
card.community_fate_rescue_program: Rescue program. Collect $75 for each mortgaged property.
card.community_fate_public_works: Public works. Pay $20 per house and $60 per hotel.
card.community_fate_portfolio_levy: Portfolio levy. Pay $20 for each property you own.
card.community_fate_second_wind: Second wind. Advance seven spaces. Buy an unowned property at a 15% discount.
card.community_fate_prison_reform: Prison reform. Keep this card to leave jail.
card.community_fate_shared_burden: Shared burden. Pay $25 to every player.
card.community_fate_fresh_start: Fresh start. Collect half a Start salary and move to Start without collecting again.
card.opportunity_decision_bank_call: A caller claims to work for your bank's security team.
decision.bank_call.prompt: They detected a strange purchase and ask for a verification code. What do you do?
decision.bank_call.hang_up: Hang up and call the official bank number
decision.bank_call.share_code: Share the code to block the purchase
decision.bank_call.report: Keep them talking and report the call
decision.bank_call.hang_up.result: It was a scam. You hung up in time.
decision.bank_call.share_code.scam: It was a scam and they drained part of your account.
decision.bank_call.share_code.safe: The call was legitimate and the bank rewarded your help.
decision.bank_call.report.result: You helped stop a fraud ring and earned a reward.
card.opportunity_decision_lottery: The lottery jackpot has reached a historic record.
decision.lottery.prompt: You can ignore the frenzy, buy one ticket, or bet on a full bundle.
decision.lottery.skip.result: You kept your money and watched the drawing from afar.
decision.lottery.prize: Your ticket won a smaller prize.
decision.lottery.bundle_prize: The bundle produced a substantial profit.
decision.lottery.super_jackpot: The bundle contained the extraordinary jackpot ticket!
card.opportunity_decision_boss_call: Your boss calls about a crisis nobody wants to handle.
decision.boss_call.prompt: They need an immediate answer and are judging your attitude. How do you respond?
decision.boss_call.solve_calmly.result: You solved the crisis and earned recognition.
decision.boss_call.bonus_won: Your boss accepted the bonus and respected your resolve.
decision.boss_call.bonus_lost: Your boss rejected the pressure and charged you for the problem.
decision.boss_call.answer_badly.result: You lost workplace benefits because of your response.
card.opportunity_decision_millionaire_fr: A friend calls from the final question of a millionaire quiz show.
decision.millionaire.prompt: Question: which is the largest ocean on Earth?
decision.millionaire.correct: Correct! Your friend shared part of the prize.
decision.millionaire.wrong: The answer was wrong and you covered part of the trip to the show.
card.opportunity_decision_startup: A startup promises to transform the market.
decision.startup.prompt: The idea is compelling, but it has no sales yet. How much do you risk?
decision.startup.small_loss: The startup closed before launching its product.
decision.startup.small_win: The startup found customers and bought back your stake.
decision.startup.all_in_loss: The startup ran out of cash and you lost the investment.
decision.startup.all_in_win: The startup was acquired and your stake multiplied.
card.opportunity_decision_recruiter: A recruiter offers you a new job.
decision.recruiter.prompt: The offer is good, but negotiating could improve it. How do you answer?
decision.recruiter.reject: Decline and keep your current job
decision.recruiter.accept.result: You signed the contract and received a starting bonus.
decision.recruiter.negotiate.win: The negotiation worked and they improved the offer.
decision.recruiter.negotiate.loss: They withdrew the offer, but you kept your current job.
decision.recruiter.reject.result: You chose stability and nothing changed.
card.community_decision_package_link: You receive a message about a package you do not remember ordering.
decision.package.prompt: The link asks for a fee to release the shipment. What do you do?
decision.package.verify: Check the tracking on the official website
decision.package.scam: The website was fake and stole your payment data.
decision.package.real: The package was real and contained an unexpected refund.
decision.package.verify.result: You reported a fake website and received a reward.
card.community_decision_raffle: The neighborhood association is holding a raffle with a huge prize.
decision.raffle.prompt: You can pass, buy one number, or improve your odds with five.
decision.raffle.skip.result: You supported the event without risking money.
decision.raffle.win: You won one of the raffle prizes.
decision.raffle.big_win: Several of your numbers won prizes.
decision.raffle.jackpot: You won the raffle's grand prize!
card.community_decision_weekend_boss: Your boss calls on your day off.
decision.weekend_boss.prompt: They want an urgent problem solved without warning. How do you respond?
decision.weekend_boss.boundary: Politely explain that you are unavailable
decision.weekend_boss.boundary.result: Your boundary was respected without consequences.
decision.weekend_boss.lie.caught: They caught the lie and removed a benefit.
card.community_decision_talent_show: Registration opens for a talent contest.
decision.talent.prompt: You can watch, perform something rehearsed, or improvise in front of everyone.
decision.talent.watch.result: You enjoyed the show without taking a risk.
decision.talent.applause: The audience loved your performance and you won a prize.
decision.talent.booed: The performance failed and you paid the expenses.
decision.talent.viral: The improvisation went viral and contracts followed.
decision.talent.disaster: The improvisation became an expensive disaster.
card.community_decision_lost_wallet: You find a wallet containing cash and identification.
decision.wallet.prompt: Nobody is nearby. What do you do with it?
decision.wallet.return: Find the owner and return it
decision.wallet.police: Turn it in to the police
decision.wallet.keep.safe: Nobody saw you and you kept the cash.
decision.wallet.keep.caught: A camera recorded everything and you paid a fine.
decision.wallet.police.result: The police found the owner and you received a reward.
card.community_decision_mystery_box: A sealed box appears at your door.
decision.mystery_box.prompt: It has no sender. You can leave it alone or open it.
decision.mystery_box.leave.result: The delivery company collected the misplaced box.
decision.mystery_box.cash: It contained a promotional cash prize.
decision.mystery_box.bill: It was a collect-on-delivery parcel and accepting it created a bill.
decision.mystery_box.pass: You found a valid pass to leave jail.
